name: Perri Melbourne Data Centre (PMDC)

address.value: 1 McArthur Street and 63 Sunshine Road, West Footscray VIC 3012
address.note: 2.72ha site incl. four-storey heritage Goldsbrough Mort woolstore; Urban Developer: 9,720 m2 of vacant land south of the woolstore fronting McArthur St (west) and Indwe St (south)

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Goldsborough Mort Wool Store", 63 Sunshine Rd - inside the development site, but Woolpert/Greenbox say the new data centre is 'sited adjacent to' the heritage woolstore, so the DC building itself is likely slightly south/west of this point; kept as site-level point

mw_it.note: MW not disclosed in any fetched source (Urban Developer, Woolpert, Greenbox, Westsider, SBS); Westsider: 'an estimated thirty-two backup generators' and 510,000 L diesel; three+ data halls over four storeys. No MW estimate made

cost_aud_m.note: Urban Developer (24 Jan 2025): 'The developer confirmed the project had a development cost of $800 million and an expected end value of $1 billion'

authority.note: DFP application to the Department of Transport and Planning (Urban Developer, fetched); Minister for Planning is DFP responsible authority. Maribyrnong council had earlier granted a subdivision permit

lodged.note: on or before 24 Jan 2025 (Urban Developer: plans 'now before' DTP via DFP); exact date not found (register blocked)

determined.note: per permit register (recorded in master.csv; register not fetchable); The Westsider (fetched) confirms 'approved in April 2025'

construction_start.note: Greenbox/Woolpert list the project as 'In progress' (design); SBS (2026) says 'approved and planned' - no construction start found

open_questions: scope: MW capacity unknown - need to confirm >= 5 MW (32 backup generators suggests well above 5 MW, but not stated)
